mapper.select: SELECT club_name FROM Club WHERE clubOwner_key = #{clubOwnerKey}

SELECT ma.apply_id, ma.apply_date, ma.apply_time, ma.status, ma.cancel_reason, ma.stadium_id, ma.clubOwner_key, ma.match_type1, ma.match_type2, ma.clubOwner_key2, ma.stadium_fee, ma.cmb_num,
home.club_name AS home_club_name, away.club_name AS away_club_name,
s.stadium_name AS stadium_name, s.region, s.addr1, s.addr2, s.zip, s.latitude, s.longitude, s.stadium_cost AS stadiumCost
FROM Match_Apply ma
INNER JOIN Club home ON ma.clubOwner_key = home.clubOwner_key
LEFT JOIN Club away ON ma.clubOwner_key2 = away.clubOwner_key
INNER JOIN Stadium s ON ma.stadium_id = s.stadium_id
WHERE 1 = 1
AND (ma.clubOwner_key = #{clubOwnerKey} OR ma.clubOwner_key2 = #{clubOwnerKey})
ORDER BY ma.apply_date ASC, ma.apply_time ASC, ma.apply_id DESC
SELECT apply_id, apply_date, apply_time, status, cancel_reason, stadium_id, clubOwner_key, match_type1, match_type2, clubOwner_key2, stadium_fee,cmb_num FROM Match_Apply WHERE apply_id = #{applyId}

SELECT a.apply_id, a.apply_date, a.apply_time, a.status, a.cancel_reason, a.stadium_id, a.clubOwner_key, a.match_type1, a.match_type2, a.clubOwner_key2, a.stadium_fee, a.cmb_num, s.stadium_name, c.club_name AS home_club_name
FROM Match_Apply a LEFT JOIN Stadium s ON a.stadium_id = s.stadium_id LEFT JOIN Club c ON a.clubOwner_key = c.clubOwner_key
WHERE a.apply_id = #{apply_id} AND a.status = 3 AND a.clubOwner_key2 IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match_Apply WHERE cmb_num = #{cmb_num} AND clubOwner_key2 = #{clubOwner_key2}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match_Apply WHERE cmb_num = #{cmb_num} AND clubOwner_key = #{clubOwner_key2}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Match_Apply (apply_id, apply_date, apply_time, status, cancel_reason, stadium_id, clubOwner_key, match_type1, match_type2, clubOwner_key2, stadium_fee, cmb_num) VALUES (apply_id_seq.NEXTVAL, #{apply_date}, #{apply_time}, 2, NULL, #{stadium_id}, #{clubOwner_key}, #{match_type1}, #{match_type2}, #{clubOwner_key2}, #{stadium_fee}, #{cmb_num})
mapper.select:
SELECT ma.apply_id, ma.apply_date, ma.apply_time, ma.status, ma.cancel_reason, ma.stadium_id, ma.clubOwner_key, ma.match_type1, ma.match_type2, ma.clubOwner_key2, ma.stadium_fee, ma.cmb_num,
s.stadium_name, s.region, s.addr1, s.addr2, s.zip, s.latitude, s.longitude,
home.club_name AS home_club_name, away.club_name AS away_club_name,
CASE WHEN ma.clubOwner_key = #{clubOwner_key} THEN 'HOME' WHEN ma.clubOwner_key2 = #{clubOwner_key} THEN 'AWAY' END AS my_team_type,
CASE WHEN ma.clubOwner_key = #{clubOwner_key} THEN ma.clubOwner_key2 WHEN ma.clubOwner_key2 = #{clubOwner_key} THEN ma.clubOwner_key END AS opponent_clubOwner_key,
CASE WHEN ma.clubOwner_key = #{clubOwner_key} THEN away.club_name WHEN ma.clubOwner_key2 = #{clubOwner_key} THEN home.club_name END AS opponent_club_name
FROM Match_Apply ma
INNER JOIN Stadium s ON ma.stadium_id = s.stadium_id
INNER JOIN Club home ON ma.clubOwner_key = home.clubOwner_key
LEFT JOIN Club away ON ma.clubOwner_key2 = away.clubOwner_key WHERE(ma.clubOwner_key = #{clubOwner_key} OR ma.clubOwner_key2 = #{clubOwner_key}) ORDER BY ma.apply_date DESC, ma.apply_time ASC, ma.apply_id DESC

SELECT ma.apply_id, ma.apply_date, ma.apply_time, ma.status, ma.stadium_id, ma.clubOwner_key, ma.match_type1, ma.match_type2, ma.cmb_num,
s.stadium_name, s.region,
c.club_name AS home_club_name
FROM Match_Apply ma
INNER JOIN Stadium s ON ma.stadium_id = s.stadium_id
INNER JOIN Club c ON ma.clubOwner_key = c.clubOwner_key
WHERE ma.status = 3 AND ma.clubOwner_key2 IS NULL AND TRUNC(ma.apply_date) = TO_DATE(#{applyDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ma.apply_time = #{applyTime} AND s.region = #{region} AND ma.match_type1 = #{matchType1} AND ma.match_type2 = #{matchType2} ORDER BY ma.apply_id DESC
